en.title: Good Subsequences
en.description:
Count the non-empty subsequences in which every character that appears has the same frequency, modulo 1,000,000,007. Choosing the same character from different indices gives different subsequences.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as defined in this problem statement.
en.input: One line containing word, consisting only of lowercase English letters; this site adds 1≤|word|≤200000 to fill in the length upper bound the original problem did not give.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying non-empty subsequences modulo 1,000,000,007.
en.explanation: Enumerate the common frequency k. For each character that appears at least k times, either choose its indices in C(count,k) ways or leave the character out; the option where nothing is chosen must be excluded.
